description: This file defines a React functional component 'LoggingSettings' that provides a user interface for configuring logging callbacks and integrations within a team management context. It includes UI elements for selecting callback types, managing disabled callbacks, and configuring dynamic parameters for specific logging callbacks.

methods.name: addLoggingConfig
methods.description: Adds a new logging configuration entry with default callback type and empty callback name and variables.

methods.name: removeLoggingConfig
methods.description: Removes a logging configuration entry at the specified index.

methods.name: updateLoggingConfig
methods.description: Updates a specific field (callback_name, callback_type) of a logging configuration at a given index.

methods.name: updateCallbackVar
methods.description: Updates a specific callback variable in a logging configuration at a given index.

methods.name: renderDynamicParams
methods.description: Renders additional dynamic parameter input fields based on the selected callback's dynamic_params.
